frontier.hypothesis: combine_movables' match/done path is unexplored: a movable that combine_movables marks 'done ... matches N' is skipped by the move test at loop.c:1584 entirely, never reaching the threshold inequality at all.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c:1245-1290 pairs movables that load the same value into different pseudos, setting the later one's match pointer and done flag and folding its lifetime and savings into the survivor. move_movables' outer guard is 'if (!m->done && ...)', so a matched movable is never tested against threshold * savings * lifetime. This session observed the shape in the wild: c_innerfirst's dump prints 'Insn 82: regno 94 (life 1), done move-insn matches 33' alongside a survivor whose savings had risen to 2. The unknown is what the pass emits for a matched movable when the SURVIVOR itself is not moved, and whether reg_map's substitution can leave the constant materialised in-loop byte-neutrally.
frontier.next_probe: Force a second in-loop pseudo holding 0x91A2B3C5 (for example by spelling a second division by 1800 whose dividend cse1 cannot prove equal to the first), read the .loop dump for the match/done lines and for whether the survivor is 'not desirable', and measure asm_lines and sandbox. Then repeat with the survivor placed so it fails the threshold test, to see whether both copies stay in-loop and what that costs in bytes.

frontier.hypothesis: The threshold-halving route is now purely an admissibility question, and the only admissible version of it would be a value this function genuinely computes and genuinely discards.
frontier.mechanism: The two class kills recorded this session (loop.c:2199 and flow.c:1484) show that any byte-free CALL_INSN in the loop must be a libcall block with a dead result. The Judge's standing constraint bans gratuitous float/long-long cast chains whose sole purpose is to emit a libcall, and the 2026-09-05 layer-1 FAIL rejected the DImode dead store. So the axis is not blocked by mechanism but by the absence of a natural dead DImode or float quantity in a function that formats a 30 Hz frame count into minutes, seconds and hundredths.
frontier.next_probe: Before spending another carrier design on this, settle the semantics question from outside the compiler: sweep the other BB2 call sites that write the same display struct (offsets 0x21-0x24 and 0x2D-0x30 of the func_80077D00 record) and the sibling record readers of D_80106A58 - func_80035280 is still INCLUDE_ASM and reads the same base - for evidence that the original code computed a wider intermediate (a centisecond total, a rank, a checksum) that this function does not store. A negative census is itself a citable result for the eventual foreclosure record.

frontier.hypothesis: The two declaration puns in candidate.c remain a hard submission blocker on ANY distance-0 body, independent of the floor, and this session's ablation shows the d0 result is load-bearing on one of them.
frontier.mechanism: candidate.c needs extern u8 D_80106A58[24] at src/code6cac_c2.c:156 to reach 0 - the body alone measures 3 - and D_80106A58 is a per-word splat sub-symbol of g_file_disc_type at 0x80106A54. The aggregate-merge family requires the merge at the DECLARATION in include/*.h with prongs (a)-(e), and prong (c)'s 2026-09-03 amendment requires the sub-symbol rows to carry an alias-of suffix because func_80035280 is still INCLUDE_ASM. A per-use cast is an auto-FAIL, and the current spelling is also on this function's banned_constructs list.
frontier.next_probe: Prong (a) is satisfiable from base-register and stride evidence rather than splat-name adjacency: the target walks one base register with addiu $a2, $a2, 0x8 at 8003C830 and reads 0x0($a2) and 0x4($a2), an 8-byte stride over a two-field record. Draft the header-canonical merged declaration with the alias-of suffix on the sub-symbol rows and route it as an integration handoff before any candidate-ready, so that a future d0 body is not blocked on it a second time.
